desc: S. 2226, the Senate's National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2024. As engrossed in the Senate on 27 July 2023 it carried DIVISION G--UNIDENTIFIED ANOMALOUS PHENOMENA DISCLOSURE (secs. 9001-9015), the full UAP Disclosure Act of 2023. The FY2024 NDAA was ultimately enacted through the House vehicle H.R. 2670 as Public Law 118-31, with Division G reduced to three sections.
